name: Poised Ward
description: Spread a thin even film of qi over the chest and forearms to blunt a glancing blow on the user.

name: Shoving Ward
description: Thrust the palm forward behind a hardened film of qi to push an attacker off balance.

name: Second Skin
description: Hold a close film of qi against the skin through a long exchange so each blow lands softer on the user.

name: Breath Brace
description: Tighten the ward on an out-breath to sink the weight of one heavy hit through the user's stance into the ground.

name: Near Step
description: Step to the near side of a threatened ally and raise a ward across the gap in one motion.

name: Glancing Screen
description: Tilt a flat ward so an incoming strike slides along its face and away from the user.

name: Warmed Palm
description: Lay a warmed palm of qi over an ally's bruise or shallow cut to ease the pain and close the surface.

name: Felt Edge
description: Feel the face of the ward for the weight and direction of an incoming blow before it lands on the user.

name: Lean Shell
description: Draw a narrow shell of qi over the side facing the opponent and leave the other side free to move.

name: Rolling Cover
description: Roll the ward along the arm so a thrown or dropped thing slides off the user without catching.

name: Tucked Hold
description: Tuck chin and shoulder behind a dense patch of qi to soak a blow aimed at the user's head.

name: Ally Fold
description: Fold the ward outward from the user's side to cover the ally standing at the user's shoulder.

name: Pacing Ward
description: Advance in short steps while carrying a thin ward so it stays between the user and the striker.

name: Quick Tending
description: Press two fingers of qi to an ally's wound to hold the bleeding shut for a few breaths.

name: Even Veil
description: Breathe out and lay a veil of qi of the same thickness over the whole front of the user's body.

name: Mingled Breath
description: Breathe in time beside an ally and let a thin layer of the user's ward settle over the ally's guard.

name: Exhale Ward
description: Snap a hard ward into place on the out-breath just as a strike arrives at the user's ribs.

name: Held Lung
description: Hold the breath to pack the ward dense and soak a blow to the user's chest without losing footing.

name: Outer Skin Ward
description: Keep a second thin layer of qi riding outside the first so a blow must break two layers to reach the user.

name: Counted Brace
description: Count each blow against the ward and turn the third aside with a sharp tilt of the forearm.

name: Pulse Hearing
description: Feel the rhythm of an ally's pulse through the shared ward to know when the ally is near the edge of strain.

name: Near Ward
description: Slide one pace to the side of a person in danger and raise a ward before the strike arrives.

name: Between Hold
description: Plant the feet and hold a broad ward in front of both the user and the ally behind.

name: Taken Blow
description: Step into the line of a blow aimed at an ally and take it on a dense ward at the user's back.

name: Lent Mantle
description: Pass a thin mantle of the user's qi to an ally's shoulders so the ally's next guard holds firmer.

name: Calm Hands
description: Rest both hands on a shaking ally and steady the pulse and breath with slow warm qi.

name: Even Plate
description: Press qi into a flat plate of equal thickness across the user's front so no spot is thin.

name: Skin Thickening
description: Thicken the ward over the user's skin a little at a time through a long guard.

name: Mapped Ward
description: Run a pulse of qi across the user's own ward to find any thin spot before an opponent does.

name: Layered Shell
description: Stack two thin shells of qi with a gap between so the first shock dies before it reaches the second.

name: Dulling Sheath
description: Wrap the forearm in a damping sheath of qi that takes the sharpness off a cutting edge.

name: Barrier Press
description: Drive the whole flat of a ward forward into an opponent to shove the opponent back a pace.

name: Bearing Plate
description: Set a heavy plate of qi under the lead shoulder and let the legs carry the shock of a hit.

name: Knit Touch
description: Press a hand of knitting qi to an ally's torn skin to draw the edges together and stop the flow.

name: Flat Screen
description: Hold a flat ward at a set slant so a strike meets its face and glides past the user.

name: Slant Cover
description: Angle the ward over the shoulder to carry a downward blow out and away from the user's neck.

name: Flat Hold
description: Keep a wide flat ward raised at the same height and angle for as long as the exchange lasts.

name: Rim Swerving
description: Flick the rim of the ward outward to knock a thrust off line before it reaches the user.

name: Gentle Lean
description: Lean off the line of a blow behind a held ward so the strike finds only the ward's edge.

name: Slope Divining
description: Read the angle of an incoming strike from how it slides across the ward and call it to an ally.

name: Lone Ward
description: Raise one clean ward of qi at the forearm and learn its thickness and its limit.

name: Paired Shields
description: Raise a ward at each forearm and hold them as one to guard the whole front.

name: Wide Cover
description: Spread the ward wide enough to cover the user and one ally and hold it through the exchange.

name: Cinch Wrap
description: Wrap a band of the user's qi about an ally's arm so a blow on that arm lands lighter.

name: Ward Crown
description: Close the ward over the crown of the head to soak a falling strike without bending the neck.

name: Gripping Ward
description: Close a ward about an opponent's wrist and snap it back to knock the weapon off its line.

name: Soothing Warmth
description: Warm the sore muscle of an ally with slow qi until the cramp and the ache let go.

name: Rootset Ward
description: Sink the heels and let the ward draw its weight up from the ground through the user's legs.

name: Planted Guard
description: Plant the lead foot and send the force of a heavy blow down through the knee into the ground.

name: Settled Hold
description: Stay low and still behind a ward that the stance holds up without further effort of qi.

name: Braced Rise
description: Rise from a crouch behind the ward and shift one pace without letting the ward gap.

name: Footing Sense
description: Feel through the soles whether the ground under the user and an ally will carry a heavy blow.

name: Softened Cover
description: Lay a soft padded ward over the user so that a blow lands as a push and not as a strike.

name: Cushion Wrap
description: Wrap the ward round a falling or thrown weight and let it sink into the padding before it bites.

name: Dull Fall
description: Roll as the ward cushions a fall so the user lands without a bruise.

name: Cradle Hands
description: Cup both hands over a hurt ally and hold a soft ward round them while the exchange passes.

name: Mild Mend
description: Spread slow qi under the palm over an ally's sprain and bruise until the swelling begins to ease.

name: Bruise Reading
description: Run a thread of qi over an ally's body to find which blows landed hard and where.

name: Firm Warding
description: Raise a plain ward of qi at the forearm and meet the blow squarely on its face.

name: Open Shield
description: Spread the ward from a narrow point into a wide disc as the strike closes in.

name: Close Barrier
description: Draw the ward tight against the body to save qi when the opponent's blows come fast.

name: Turning Aegis
description: Spin the ward on its centre to throw off a glancing strike as it touches.

name: Covering Step
description: Step behind an ally's shoulder and shape the ward to cover both until the strike has passed.

name: Gifted Edge
description: Touch an ally's guard and add a thin edge of the user's ward to its rim.

name: Layer Count
description: Count the layers left in an ally's ward by touch and tell the ally how many blows remain.
